name: Files
when_to_use: Taking files in, reading them, converting them and handing finished files back. Fetch what a person shared (a chat upload, a link, a gs:// object, a git repository, a Drive link) into the mission's inbox; read PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint and HTML as text; convert between formats, render pages to PNG, merge or split PDFs; make Word, PDF, HTML, PowerPoint, Excel and CSV files from Markdown, HTML, CSV or JSON you wrote; and share a result as a download on the mission, optionally saved to Drive too.
